method: Linear slope of Reservoirs pressure in compressor-off segments (motor current < 1.0 A, >= 3.0 min), excluding +-1 day around labelled failures. min/max: 10th and 90th percentile across segments. median_ci95: bootstrap (1000 resamples, seed 11).
limits: Metro train in Porto, not a loco. Off-segment decay includes normal air use (brakes, doors), so it is an upper bound on pure leakage. The median is above the loco dispatch limit in config/loco.json (0.067 bar/min), which fits that reading.
